cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll arrange the trophies. Mine fits on the top shelf; yours needs its own table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is the consolation prize. Mine says first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First to need extra furniture. I'll clear a table if you admit mine's easier to live with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just put mine where visitors can read the name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You choose the spot. I'll put mine beside it and we'll see which of us can let the visitors ask.
